prepared_by: independent test writer, round 2 (hand-verified with git)
notes: Round-2 held-out questions, written by hand with read-only git (git show/log/diff -M/tag --contains) AFTER round-1 (E2) results were seen; disjoint from every round-1 question in evals/repo_questions/*.json. No rw.repo output was consulted. Do not edit after any run: changes require a new evaluation retaining the originals. expected_facts holds the concrete answer (values are Python literals; `first_tag_containing` is the earliest tag matching the repo's tag_pattern whose commit has the fix commit as an ancestor; fix `state` is judged on content).

questions.question: At v2.32.0, what is the value of DEFAULT_POOLSIZE in requests.adapters?
At v2.32.0, what is DEFAULT_REDIRECT_LIMIT set to in requests.models?
At v2.32.0, what is the value of CONTENT_CHUNK_SIZE in requests.models?
questions.expected_answer: It is the expression 10 * 1024 (= 10240 bytes), not a plain literal (src/requests/models.py line 80).

questions.question: At v2.32.0, which exception does Session.get_adapter raise?
questions.expected_answer: InvalidSchema, when no adapter matches the URL (src/requests/sessions.py 781-792, raise at 792).

questions.question: At v2.32.0, which exception types does HTTPAdapter.cert_verify raise?
questions.expected_answer: Only OSError (three raise sites: lines 309, 331, 336) for missing CA bundle / cert / key files.

questions.question: At v2.32.0, what exception does SessionRedirectMixin.resolve_redirects raise when there are too many redirects?
questions.expected_answer: TooManyRedirects (raised at sessions.py line 191 inside resolve_redirects, lines 159-280).

questions.question: Is commit 96ba401c ('Only use hostname to do netrc lookup instead of netloc') present at v2.32.4, and which tag first contains it?
questions.expected_answer: PRESENT: get_netrc_auth uses `host = ri.hostname` (src/requests/utils.py line 232 at v2.32.4); first tag containing the commit is v2.32.4.

questions.question: Is commit 96ba401c (netrc lookup by hostname) present at v2.32.3?
questions.expected_answer: ABSENT: at v2.32.3 get_netrc_auth still splits ri.netloc on ':'; the fix first ships in v2.32.4.

questions.question: Between v2.31.0 and v2.32.0, what are the old and new paths of the module holding __version__, and was it edited?
questions.expected_answer: requests/__version__.py -> src/requests/__version__.py (git -M similarity 83%, i.e. renamed and edited: version strings bumped).

questions.question: Which functions or methods under src/ changed between v2.32.3 and v2.32.4?
questions.expected_answer: Modified: utils.super_len, utils.get_netrc_auth, models.Response.json (docstring only); compat.py gained module-level is_urllib3_1 detection; no function added or removed; no rename.
